questions.stem: Two cylinders have the same height. Cylinder A has radius $r$ and Cylinder B has radius $2r$. How many times larger is the volume of Cylinder B compared to Cylinder A?
questions.explanation: Volume of A $= \pi r^2 h$. Volume of B $= \pi (2r)^2 h = 4\pi r^2 h$. So B is $4$ times larger.
